@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Aleo|Heebo|Open+Sans&display=swap');

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5 {
	font-family: Aleo;
}

li {
	font-family: Heebo; /* was Catamaran */
	font-size: 12px;
}

#p-logo > a
{
	background-color: #BEEBFF;
}

body {
	font-family: Heebo;
	background-image: none;
	background-color: #BEEBFF;  /* thats what you needed, fool */
}

/* this is what got the sidebar boxes to change color */
#p-navigation > div, 
#p-search > div,
#p-interaction > div,
#p-tb > div,
#p-coll-print_export > div
{
	background-color: #E6F2FF;
}

#content, /* this is what got the padding to turn blue */
#bodyContent {
	background-color: #FBFDFE;
}
